1.text: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of mount Ephraim, N his name was Elkanah, tha son of Jeroham, tha son of Elihu, tha son of Tohu, tha son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:
N he had two wives; tha name of tha one was Hannah, N tha name of tha other Peninnah: N Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
N dis man went up out of his city yearly 2 worship N 2 sacrifice 2 tha LORD of hosts in Shiloh. N tha two sons of Eli, Hophni N Phinehas, tha priests of tha LORD, were there.
N when tha time was dat Elkanah offered, he gave 2 Peninnah his wife, N 2 all her sons N her daughters, portions:
But 2 Hannah he gave a worthy portion; 4 he loved Hannah: but tha LORD had shut up her womb.
N her adversary also provoked her sore, 4 2 make her fret, because tha LORD had shut up her womb.
N as he did so year by year, when she went up 2 tha house of tha LORD, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, N did not eat.
Then said Elkanah her husband 2 her, Hannah, why weepest u? N why eat u not? N why is ur heart grieved? am not I better 2 u than ten sons?
So Hannah rose up after dey had eaten in Shiloh, N after dey had drunk. Now Eli tha priest sat upon a seat by a post of tha temple of tha LORD.
N she was in bitterness of soul, N prayed 2 tha LORD, N wept sore.

N she vowed a vow, N said, O LORD of hosts, if u will indeed look on tha affliction of thine handmaid, N remember me, N not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give 2 thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him 2 tha LORD all tha days of his life, N there shall no razor come upon his head.
N it happened, as she continued prayin before tha LORD, dat Eli marked her mouth.
Now Hannah, she spoke in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
N Eli said 2 her, How long will u be drunken? put away ur wine from u.
N Hannah answered, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before tha LORD.
Count not thine handmaid 4 a daughter of Belial: 4 out of tha abundance of my complaint N grief have I spoken until now.
Then Eli answered, Go in peace: N tha God of Israel grant u ur petition dat u have asked of him.
N she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in ur sight. So tha woman went her way, N did eat, N her countenance was no more sad.
N dey rose up in tha morning early, N worshipped before tha LORD, N returned, N came 2 their house 2 Ramah: N Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; N tha LORD remembered her.
So it happened, when tha time was come about after Hannah had conceived, dat she bare a son, N called his name Samuel, sayin, Because I have asked him of tha LORD.
N tha man Elkanah, N all his house, went up 2 offer 2 tha LORD tha yearly sacrifice, N his vow.
But Hannah went not up; 4 she said 2 her husband, I will not go up until tha child be weaned, N then I will bring him, dat he may appear before tha LORD, N there abide 4 ever.
N Elkanah her husband said 2 her, Do what seems u good; tarry until u have weaned him; only tha LORD establish his word. So tha woman stayed, N gave her son suck until she weaned him.
N when she had weaned him, she took him up wit her, wit three bullocks, N one ephah of flour, N a bottle of wine, N brought him 2 tha house of tha LORD in Shiloh: N tha child was young.
N dey killed a bullock, N brought tha child 2 Eli.
N she said, Oh my lord, as ur soul lives, my lord, I am tha woman dat stood by u here, prayin 2 tha LORD.
4 dis child I prayed; N tha LORD has given me my petition which I asked of him:
Therefore also I have lent him 2 tha LORD; as long as he lives he shall be lent 2 tha LORD. N he worshipped tha LORD there.

2.text: N Hannah prayed, N said, My heart rejoices in tha LORD, mine horn is exalted in tha LORD: my mouth is enlarged over mine opps; because I rejoice in ur salvation.
There is none holy as tha LORD: 4 there is none beside u: neither is there any rock like our God.
Talk no more so exceeding proudly; don’t let arrogancy come out of ur mouth: 4 tha LORD is a God of knowledge, N by him actions r weighed.
Tha bows of tha mighty men r broken, N dey dat stumbled r girded wit strength.
Dey dat were full have hired out themselves 4 bread; N dey dat were hungry ceased: so dat tha barren has born seven; N she dat has many children is grew feeble.
Tha LORD kills, N makes alive: he brings down 2 tha grave, N brings up.
Tha LORD makes poor, N makes rich: he brings low, N lifts up.

He raises up tha poor out of tha dust, N lifts up tha beggar from tha dunghill, 2 set ’em among princes, N 2 make ’em inherit tha throne of glory: 4 tha pillars of tha earth r tha LORD’s, N he has set tha world upon ’em.
He will keep tha feet of his saints, N tha wicked shall be silent in darkness; 4 by strength shall no man prevail.

Tha adversaries of tha LORD shall be broken 2 pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon ’em: tha LORD shall judge tha ends of tha earth; N he shall give strength 2 his king, N exalt tha horn of his anointed.
N Elkanah went 2 Ramah 2 his house. N tha child did minister 2 tha LORD before Eli tha priest.
Now tha sons of Eli were sons of Belial; dey knew not tha LORD.
N tha priests’ custom wit tha people was, dat, when any man offered sacrifice, tha priest’s servant came, while tha flesh was in seething, wit a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;
N he struck it in2 tha pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all dat tha fleshhook brought up tha priest took 4 himself. So dey did in Shiloh 2 all tha Israelites dat came there.
Also before dey burnt tha fat, tha priest’s servant came, N said 2 tha man dat sacrificed, Give flesh 2 roast 4 tha priest; 4 he will not have sodden flesh of u, but raw.
N if any man said 2 him, Let ’em not fail 2 burn tha fat presently, N then take as much as ur soul desires; then he would answer him, no; but u will give it me now: N if not, I will take it by force.
So tha sin of tha young men was very great before tha LORD: 4 men abhorred tha offering of tha LORD.
But Samuel ministered before tha LORD, bein a child, girded wit a linen ephod.
Moreover his mother made him a little coat, N brought it 2 him from year 2 year, when she came up wit her husband 2 offer tha yearly sacrifice.
N Eli blessed Elkanah N his wife, N said, tha LORD give u seed of dis woman 4 tha loan which is lent 2 tha LORD. N dey went 2 their own home.
N tha LORD visited Hannah, so dat she conceived, N bare three sons N two daughters. N tha child Samuel grew before tha LORD.
Now Eli was very old, N heard all dat his sons did 2 all Israel; N how dey lay wit tha women dat assembled at tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation.
N he said 2 ’em, Why do y’all such things? 4 I hear of ur evil dealings by all dis people.
No, my sons; 4 it is no good report dat I hear: y’all make tha LORD’s people 2 transgress.

If one man sin against another, tha judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against tha LORD, who shall intreat 4 him? even so dey listened not 2 tha voice of their father, because tha LORD would kill ’em.
N tha child Samuel grew on, N was in favour both wit tha LORD, N also wit men.
N there came a man of God 2 Eli, N said 2 him, like dis says tha LORD, Did I plainly appear 2 tha house of ur father, when dey were in Egypt in Pharaoh’s house?

N did I choose him out of all tha tribes of Israel 2 be my priest, 2 offer upon mine altar, 2 burn incense, 2 wear an ephod before me? N did I give 2 tha house of ur father all tha offerings made by fire of tha children of Israel?
So kick y’all at my sacrifice N at mine offering, which I have commanded in my habitation; N honour ur sons above me, 2 make y’all fat wit tha chiefest of all tha offerings of Israel my people?

So tha LORD God of Israel says, I said indeed dat ur house, N tha house of ur father, should walk before me 4 ever: but now tha LORD says, Be it far from me; 4 ’em dat honour me I will honour, N dey dat despise me shall be lightly esteemed.
Look, tha days come, dat I will cut off thine arm, N tha arm of ur father’s house, dat there shall not be an old man in thine house.
N u will see an opp in my habitation, in all tha wealth which God shall give Israel: N there shall not be an old man in thine house 4 ever.
N tha man of thine, whom I shall not cut off from mine altar, shall be 2 consume ur eyes, N 2 grieve thine heart: N all tha increase of thine house shall die in tha flower of their age.
N dis shall be a sign 2 u, dat shall come upon ur two sons, on Hophni N Phinehas; in one day dey shall die both of ’em.
N I will raise me up a faithful priest, dat shall do according 2 dat which is in mine heart N in my mind: N I will build him a sure house; N he shall walk before mine anointed 4 ever.

N it will happen, dat every one dat is left in thine house shall come N crouch 2 him 4 a piece of silver N a morsel of bread, N shall say, Put me, I pray u, in2 one of tha priests’ offices, dat I may eat a piece of bread.

3.text: N tha child Samuel ministered 2 tha LORD before Eli. N tha word of tha LORD was precious in dose days; there was no open vision.
N it happened at dat time, when Eli was laid down in his place, N his eyes began 2 wax dim, dat he could not see;
N ere tha lamp of God went out in tha temple of tha LORD, where tha ark of God was, N Samuel was laid down 2 sleep;
Dat tha LORD called Samuel: N he answered, Here am I.
N he ran 2 Eli, N said, Here am I; 4 u calledst me. N he said, I called not; lie down again. N he went N lay down.
N tha LORD called yet again, Samuel. N Samuel arose N went 2 Eli, N said, Here am I; 4 u did call me. N he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.
Now Samuel did not yet know tha LORD, neither was tha word of tha LORD yet revealed 2 him., N before tha word of tha LORD was revealed 2 him
N tha LORD called Samuel again tha third time. N he arose N went 2 Eli, N said, Here am I; 4 u did call me. N Eli perceived dat tha LORD had called tha child.
Therefore Eli said 2 Samuel, Go, lie down: N it will be, if he call u, dat u will say, Speak, LORD; 4 ur servant hears. So Samuel went N lay down in his place.
N tha LORD came, N stood, N called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; 4 ur servant hears.
N tha LORD said 2 Samuel, look, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both tha ears of every one dat hears it shall tingle.
In dat day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end.
4 I have told him dat I will judge his house 4 ever 4 tha iniquity which he knows; because his sons made themselves vile, N he restrained ’em not.
N therefore I have sworn 2 tha house of Eli, dat tha iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be purged wit sacrifice nor offering 4 ever.
N Samuel lay until tha morning, N opened tha doors of tha house of tha LORD. N Samuel feared 2 show Eli tha vision.
Then Eli called Samuel, N said, Samuel, my son. N he answered, Here am I.
N he said, What is tha thing dat tha Lord has said 2 u? I pray u hide it not from me: God do so 2 u, N more also, if u hide any thing from me of all tha things dat he said 2 u.
N Samuel told him every whit, N hid nothing from him. N he said, It is tha LORD: let him do what seems him good.
N Samuel grew, N tha LORD was wit him, N did let none of his words fall 2 tha ground.
N all Israel from Dan even 2 Beer-sheba knew dat Samuel was established 2 be a prophet of tha LORD.
N tha LORD appeared again in Shiloh: 4 tha LORD revealed himself 2 Samuel in Shiloh by tha word of tha LORD.

4.text: N tha word of Samuel came 2 all Israel. Now Israel went out against tha Philistines 2 battle, N pitched beside Eben-ezer: N tha Philistines pitched in Aphek.
N tha Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: N when dey joined battle, Israel was struck before tha Philistines: N dey killed of tha army in tha field about four thousand men.

N when tha people were come in2 tha camp, tha elders of Israel said, so has tha LORD struck us 2 day before tha Philistines? Let us fetch tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD out of Shiloh 2 us, dat, when it comes among us, it may save us out of tha hand of our opps.

So tha people sent 2 Shiloh, dat dey might bring from thence tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD of hosts, which lives between tha cherubims: N tha two sons of Eli, Hophni N Phinehas, were there wit tha ark of tha covenant of God.
N when tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD came in2 tha camp, all Israel shouted wit a great shout, so dat tha earth rang again.
N when tha Philistines heard tha noise of tha shout, dey said, What means tha noise of dis great shout in tha camp of tha Hebrews? N dey understood dat tha ark of tha LORD was come in2 tha camp.
N tha Philistines were afraid, 4 dey said, God is come in2 tha camp. N dey said, woe 2 us! 4 there has not been such a thing before now.
Woe 2 us! who shall deliver us out of tha hand of dese mighty Gods? dese r tha Gods dat struck tha Egyptians wit all tha plagues in tha wilderness.
Be strong, N quit y’all like men, O y’all Philistines, dat y’all don’t be servants 2 tha Hebrews, as dey have been 2 u: quit y’all like men, N fight.
N tha Philistines fought, N Israel was struck, N dey fled every man in2 his tent: N there was a very great slaughter; 4 there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen.
N tha ark of God was taken; N tha two sons of Eli, Hophni N Phinehas, were killed.
N there ran a man of Benjamin out of tha army, N came 2 Shiloh tha same day wit his clothes rent, N wit earth upon his head.
N when he came, look, Eli sat upon a seat by tha wayside watchin: 4 his heart trembled 4 tha ark of God. N when tha man came in2 tha city, N told it, all tha city cried out.
N when Eli heard tha noise of tha cryin, he said, What means tha noise of dis tumult? N tha man came in hastily, N told Eli.
Now Eli was ninety N eight years old; N his eyes were dim, dat he could not see.
N tha man said 2 Eli, I am he dat came out of tha army, N I fled 2 day out of tha army. N he said, What is there done, my son?
N tha messenger answered, Israel is fled before tha Philistines, N there has been also a great slaughter among tha people, N ur two sons also, Hophni N Phinehas, r dead, N tha ark of God is taken.

N it happened, when he made mention of tha ark of God, dat he fell from off tha seat backward by tha side of tha gate, N his neck broke, N he died: 4 he was an old man, N heavy. N he had judged Israel forty years.

N his daughter in law, Phinehas’ wife, was wit child, near 2 be delivered: N when she heard tha tidings dat tha ark of God was taken, N dat her father in law N her husband were dead, she bowed herself N travailed; 4 her pains came upon her.
N about tha time of her death tha women dat stood by her said 2 her, don’t fear; 4 u have born a son. But she answered not, neither did she regard it.
N she named tha child I-chabod, sayin, tha glory is departed from Israel: because tha ark of God was taken, N because of her father in law N her husband.
N she said, tha glory is departed from Israel: 4 tha ark of God is taken.

5.text: N tha Philistines took tha ark of God, N brought it from Eben-ezer 2 Ashdod.
When tha Philistines took tha ark of God, dey brought it in2 tha house of Dagon, N set it by Dagon.
N when dey of Ashdod arose early on tha morrow, look, Dagon was fallen upon his face 2 tha earth before tha ark of tha LORD. N dey took Dagon, N set him in his place again.

N when dey arose early on tha morrow morning, look, Dagon was fallen upon his face 2 tha ground before tha ark of tha LORD; N tha head of Dagon N both tha palms of his hands were cut off upon tha threshold; only tha stump of Dagon was left 2 him.
Therefore neither tha priests of Dagon, nor any dat come in2 Dagon’s house, tread on tha threshold of Dagon in Ashdod 2 dis day.
But tha hand of tha LORD was heavy upon ’em of Ashdod, N he destroyed ’em, N struck ’em wit emerods, even Ashdod N tha coasts of it.
N when tha men of Ashdod saw dat it was so, dey said, tha ark of tha God of Israel shall not abide wit us: 4 his hand is sore upon us, N upon Dagon our god.

Dey sent therefore N gathered all tha lords of tha Philistines 2 ’em, N said, What shall we do wit tha ark of tha God of Israel? N dey answered, Let tha ark of tha God of Israel be carried about 2 Gath. N dey carried tha ark of tha God of Israel about there.

N it was so, dat, after dey had carried it about, tha hand of tha LORD was against tha city wit a very great destruction: N he struck tha men of tha city, both small N great, N dey had emerods in their secret parts.

Therefore dey sent tha ark of God 2 Ekron. N it happened, as tha ark of God came 2 Ekron, dat tha Ekronites cried out, sayin, dey have brought about tha ark of tha God of Israel 2 us, 2 kill us N our people.

So dey sent N gathered together all tha lords of tha Philistines, N said, Send away tha ark of tha God of Israel, N let it go again 2 his own place, dat it kill us not, N our people: 4 there was a deadly destruction throughout all tha city; tha hand of God was very heavy there.
N tha men dat died not were struck wit tha emerods: N tha cry of tha city went up 2 heaven.

6.text: N tha ark of tha LORD was in tha country of tha Philistines seven months.
N tha Philistines called 4 tha priests N tha diviners, sayin, What shall we do 2 tha ark of tha LORD? tell us wherewith we shall send it 2 his place.

N dey said, If y’all send away tha ark of tha God of Israel, send it not empty; but in any wise return him a trespass offering: then y’all shall be healed, N it will be known 2 u why his hand is not removed from u.

Then said dey, What shall be tha trespass offering which we shall return 2 him? dey answered, Five golden emerods, N five golden mice, according 2 tha number of tha lords of tha Philistines: 4 one plague was on u all, N on ur lords.

So y’all shall make images of ur emerods, N images of ur mice dat mar tha land; N y’all shall give glory 2 tha God of Israel: maybe he will lighten his hand from off u, N from off ur gods, N from off ur land.
So then do y’all harden ur hearts, as tha Egyptians N Pharaoh hardened their hearts? when he had wrought wonderfully among ’em, did dey not let tha people go, N dey departed?
Now therefore make a new cart, N take two milch kine, on which there has come no yoke, N tie tha kine 2 tha cart, N bring their calves home from ’em:
N take tha ark of tha LORD, N lay it upon tha cart; N put tha jewels of gold, which y’all return him 4 a trespass offering, in a coffer by tha side of it; N send it away, dat it may go.

N see, if it goes up by tha way of his own coast 2 Beth-shemesh, then he has done us dis great evil: but if not, then we shall know dat it is not his hand dat struck us; it was a chance dat happened 2 us.
N tha men did so; N took two milch kine, N tied ’em 2 tha cart, N shut up their calves at home:
N dey laid tha ark of tha LORD upon tha cart, N tha coffer wit tha mice of gold N tha images of their emerods.

N tha kine took tha straight way 2 tha way of Beth-shemesh, N went along tha highway, lowing as dey went, N turned not aside 2 tha right hand or 2 tha left; N tha lords of tha Philistines went after ’em 2 tha border of Beth-shemesh.
N dey of Beth-shemesh were reapin their wheat harvest in tha valley: N dey lifted up their eyes, N saw tha ark, N rejoiced 2 see it.
N tha cart came in2 tha field of Joshua, a Beth-shemite, N stood there, where there was a great stone: N dey clave tha wood of tha cart, N offered tha kine a burnt offering 2 tha LORD.

N tha Levites took down tha ark of tha LORD, N tha coffer dat was wit it, in which tha jewels of gold were, N put ’em on tha great stone: N tha men of Beth-shemesh offered burnt offerings N sacrificed sacrifices tha same day 2 tha LORD.
N when tha five lords of tha Philistines had seen it, dey returned 2 Ekron tha same day.
N dese r tha golden emerods which tha Philistines returned 4 a trespass offering 2 tha LORD; 4 Ashdod one, 4 Gaza one, 4 Askelon one, 4 Gath one, 4 Ekron one;

N tha golden mice, according 2 tha number of all tha citiez of tha Philistines belonging 2 tha five lords, both of fenced citiez, N of country villages, even 2 tha great stone of Abel, whereon dey set down tha ark of tha LORD: which stone remains 2 dis day in tha field of Joshua, tha Beth-shemite.

N he struck tha men of Beth-shemesh, because dey had looked in2 tha ark of tha LORD, even he struck of tha people fifty thousand N threescore N ten men: N tha people lamented, because tha LORD had struck many of tha people wit a great slaughter.
N tha men of Beth-shemesh said, Who is able 2 stand before dis holy LORD God? N 2 whom shall he go up from us?
N dey sent messengers 2 tha inhabitants of Kirjath-jearim, sayin, tha Philistines have brought again tha ark of tha LORD; come y’all down, N fetch it up 2 u.

7.text: N tha men of Kirjath-jearim came, N fetched up tha ark of tha LORD, N brought it in2 tha house of Abinadab in tha hill, N sanctified Eleazar his son 2 keep tha ark of tha LORD.
N it happened, while tha ark stayed in Kirjath-jearim, dat tha time was long; 4 it was twenty years: N all tha house of Israel lamented after tha LORD.

N Samuel spoke 2 all tha house of Israel, sayin, If y’all do return 2 tha LORD wit all ur hearts, then put away tha strange gods N Ashtaroth from among u, N prepare ur hearts 2 tha LORD, N serve him only: N he will deliver u out of tha hand of tha Philistines.
Then tha children of Israel did put away Baalim N Ashtaroth, N served tha LORD only.
N Samuel said, Gather all Israel 2 Mizpeh, N I will pray 4 u 2 tha LORD.
N dey gathered together 2 Mizpeh, N drew water, N poured it out before tha LORD, N fasted on dat day, N said there, We have sinned against tha LORD. N Samuel judged tha children of Israel in Mizpeh.

N when tha Philistines heard dat tha children of Israel were gathered together 2 Mizpeh, tha lords of tha Philistines went up against Israel. N when tha children of Israel heard it, dey were afraid of tha Philistines.
N tha children of Israel said 2 Samuel, Cease not 2 cry 2 tha LORD our God 4 us, dat he will save us out of tha hand of tha Philistines.
N Samuel took a sucking lamb, N offered it 4 a burnt offering wholly 2 tha LORD: N Samuel cried 2 tha LORD 4 Israel; N tha LORD heard him.

N as Samuel was offering up tha burnt offering, tha Philistines drew near 2 battle against Israel: but tha LORD thundered wit a great thunder on dat day upon tha Philistines, N discomfited ’em; N dey were struck before Israel.
N tha men of Israel went out of Mizpeh, N pursued tha Philistines, N struck ’em, until dey came under Beth-car.
Then Samuel took a stone, N set it between Mizpeh N Shen, N called tha name of it Eben-ezer, sayin, until now has tha LORD helped us.
So tha Philistines were subdued, N dey came no more in2 tha coast of Israel: N tha hand of tha LORD was against tha Philistines all tha days of Samuel.

N tha citiez which tha Philistines had taken from Israel were restored 2 Israel, from Ekron even 2 Gath; N tha coasts of it did Israel deliver out of tha hands of tha Philistines. N there was peace between Israel N tha Amorites.
N Samuel judged Israel all tha days of his life.
N he went from year 2 year in circuit 2 Beth-el, N Gilgal, N Mizpeh, N judged Israel in all dose places.
N his return was 2 Ramah; 4 there was his house; N there he judged Israel; N there he built an altar 2 tha LORD.

8.text: N it happened, when Samuel was old, dat he made his sons judges over Israel.
Now tha name of his firstborn was Joel; N tha name of his second, Abiah: dey were judges in Beer-sheba.
N his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, N took bribes, N perverted judgment.
Then all tha elders of Israel gathered themselves together, N came 2 Samuel 2 Ramah,
N said 2 him, look, u r old, N ur sons walk not in ur ways: now make us a king 2 judge us like all tha nations.
But tha thing displeased Samuel, when dey said, Give us a king 2 judge us. N Samuel prayed 2 tha LORD.
N tha LORD said 2 Samuel, listen 2 tha voice of tha people in all dat dey say 2 u: 4 dey have not rejected u, but dey have rejected me, dat I should not reign over ’em.
According 2 all tha works which dey have done since tha day dat I brought ’em up out of Egypt even 2 dis day, wherewith dey have forsaken me, N served other gods, so do dey also 2 u.
Now therefore listen 2 their voice: but yet protest solemnly 2 ’em, N show ’em tha manner of tha king dat shall reign over ’em.
N Samuel told all tha words of tha LORD 2 tha people dat asked of him a king.
N he said, dis will be tha manner of tha king dat shall reign over u: He will take ur sons, N appoint ’em 4 himself, 4 his chariots, N 2 be his horsemen; N some shall run before his chariots.
N he will appoint him captains over thousands, N captains over fifties; N will set ’em 2 ear his ground, N 2 reap his harvest, N 2 make his instruments of war, N instruments of his chariots.
N he will take ur daughters 2 be confectionaries, N 2 be cooks, N 2 be bakers.
N he will take ur fields, N ur vineyards, N ur oliveyards, even tha best of ’em, N give ’em 2 his servants.
N he will take tha tenth of ur seed, N of ur vineyards, N give 2 his officers, N 2 his servants.
N he will take ur menservants, N ur maidservants, N ur goodliest young men, N ur asses, N put ’em 2 his work.
He will take tha tenth of ur sheep: N y’all shall be his servants.
N y’all shall cry out in dat day because of ur king which y’all shall have chosen u; N tha LORD will not hear u in dat day.
Nevertheless tha people refused 2 obey tha voice of Samuel; N dey said, no; but we will have a king over us;
Dat we also may be like all tha nations; N dat our king may judge us, N go out before us, N fight our battles.
N Samuel heard all tha words of tha people, N he rehearsed ’em in tha ears of tha LORD.
N tha LORD said 2 Samuel, listen 2 their voice, N make ’em a king. N Samuel said 2 tha men of Israel, Go y’all every man 2 his city.

9.text: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, tha son of Abiel, tha son of Zeror, tha son of Bechorath, tha son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.

N he had a son, whose name was Saul, a choice young man, N a goodly: N there was not among tha children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders N upward he was higher than any of tha people.
N tha asses of Kish Saul’s father were lost. N Kish said 2 Saul his son, Take now one of tha servants wit u, N arise, go seek tha asses.

N he passed through mount Ephraim, N passed through tha land of Shalisha, but dey found ’em not: then dey passed through tha land of Shalim, N there dey were not: N he passed through tha land of tha Benjamites, but dey found ’em not.
N when dey were come 2 tha land of Zuph, Saul said 2 his servant dat was wit him, Come, N let us return; lest my father leave caring 4 tha asses, N take thought 4 us.
N he said 2 him, look now, there is in dis city a man of God, N he is an honourable man; all dat he says comes surely 2 pass: now let us go there; maybe he can show us our way dat we should go.
Then said Saul 2 his servant, But, look, if we go, what shall we bring tha man? 4 tha bread is spent in our vessels, N there is not a present 2 bring 2 tha man of God: what have we?
N tha servant answered Saul again, N said, look, I have here at hand tha fourth part of a shekel of silver: dat will I give 2 tha man of God, 2 tell us our way.
(Beforetime in Israel, when a man went 2 enquire of God, like dis he spoke, Come, N let us go 2 tha seer: 4 he dat is now called a Prophet was beforetime called a Seer.)
Then said Saul 2 his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So dey went 2 tha city where tha man of God was.
N as dey went up tha hill 2 tha city, dey found young maidens goin out 2 draw water, N said 2 ’em, Is tha seer here?
N dey answered ’em, N said, He is; look, he is before u: make haste now, 4 he came 2 day 2 tha city; 4 there is a sacrifice of tha people 2 day in tha high place:

As soon as y’all be come in2 tha city, y’all shall right away find him, before he go up 2 tha high place 2 eat: 4 tha people will not eat until he come, because he does bless tha sacrifice; N afterwards dey eat dat be bidden. Now therefore get u up; 4 about dis time y’all shall find him.
N dey went up in2 tha city: N when dey were come in2 tha city, look, Samuel came out against ’em, 4 2 go up 2 tha high place.
Now tha LORD had told Samuel in his ear a day before Saul came, sayin,

2 morrow about dis time I will send u a man out of tha land of Benjamin, N u will anoint him 2 be captain over my people Israel, dat he may save my people out of tha hand of tha Philistines: 4 I have looked upon my people, because their cry is come 2 me.
N when Samuel saw Saul, tha LORD said 2 him, look tha man whom I spoke 2 u of! dis same shall reign over my people.
Then Saul drew near 2 Samuel in tha gate, N said, Tell me, I pray u, where tha seer’s house is.
N Samuel answered Saul, N said, I am tha seer: go up before me 2 tha high place; 4 y’all shall eat wit me 2 day, N 2 morrow I will let u go, N will tell u all dat is in thine heart.
N as 4 thine asses dat were lost three days ago, set not ur mind on ’em; 4 dey r found. N on whom is all tha desire of Israel? Is it not on u, N on all ur father’s house?
N Saul answered, Am not I a Benjamite, of tha smallest of tha tribes of Israel? N my family tha least of all tha families of tha tribe of Benjamin? so then speak u so 2 me?
N Samuel took Saul N his servant, N brought ’em in2 tha parlour, N made ’em sit in tha chiefest place among ’em dat were bidden, which were about thirty persons.
N Samuel said 2 tha cook, Bring tha portion which I gave u, of which I said 2 u, Set it by u.

N tha cook took up tha shoulder, N dat which was upon it, N set it before Saul. N Samuel said, look dat which is left! set it before u, N eat: 4 2 dis time has it been kept 4 u since I said, I have invited tha people. So Saul did eat wit Samuel dat day.
N when dey were come down from tha high place in2 tha city, Samuel communed wit Saul upon tha top of tha house.

N dey arose early: N it happened about tha spring of tha day, dat Samuel called Saul 2 tha top of tha house, sayin, Up, dat I may send u away. N Saul arose, N dey went out both of ’em, he N Samuel, abroad.
N as dey were goin down 2 tha end of tha city, Samuel said 2 Saul, Bid tha servant pass on before us, (N he passed on,) but stand u still a while, dat I may show u tha word of God.

10.text: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, N poured it upon his head, N kissed him, N said, Is it not because tha LORD has anointed u 2 be captain over his inheritance?

When u r departed from me 2 day, then u will find two men by Rachel’s sepulchre in tha border of Benjamin at Zelzah; N dey will say 2 u, tha asses which u went 2 seek r found: N, look, ur father has left tha care of tha asses, N sorroweth 4 u, sayin, What shall I do 4 my son?

Then will u go on forward from thence, N u will come 2 tha plain of Tabor, N there shall meet u three men goin up 2 God 2 Beth-el, one carryin three kids, N another carryin three loaves of bread, N another carryin a bottle of wine:
N dey will greet u, N give u two loaves of bread; which u will receive of their hands.

After dat u will come 2 tha hill of God, where is tha garrison of tha Philistines: N it will happen, when u r come there 2 tha city, dat u will meet a company of prophets comin down from tha high place wit a psaltery, N a tabret, N a pipe, N a harp, before ’em; N dey shall prophesy:
N tha Spirit of tha LORD will come upon u, N u will prophesy wit ’em, N will be turned in2 another man.
N let it be, when dese signs r come 2 u, dat u do as occasion serve u; 4 God is wit u.

N u will go down before me 2 Gilgal; N, look, I will come down 2 u, 2 offer burnt offerings, N 2 sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days will u tarry, till I come 2 u, N show u what u will do.
N it was so, dat when he had turned his back 2 go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: N all dose signs came 2 pass dat day.
N when dey came there 2 tha hill, look, a company of prophets met him; N tha Spirit of God came upon him, N he prophesied among ’em.

N it happened, when all dat knew him beforetime saw dat, look, he prophesied among tha prophets, then tha people said one 2 another, What is dis dat is come 2 tha son of Kish? Is Saul also among tha prophets?
N one of tha same place answered, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among tha prophets?
N when he had made an end of prophesying, he came 2 tha high place.
N Saul’s uncle said 2 him N 2 his servant, where went y’all? N he said, 2 seek tha asses: N when we saw dat dey were no where, we came 2 Samuel.
N Saul’s uncle said, Tell me, I pray u, what Samuel said 2 u.
N Saul said 2 his uncle, He told us plainly dat tha asses were found. But of tha matter of tha kingdom, whereof Samuel spoke, he told him not.
N Samuel called tha people together 2 tha LORD 2 Mizpeh;

N said 2 tha children of Israel, like dis says tha LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, N delivered u out of tha hand of tha Egyptians, N out of tha hand of all kingdoms, N of ’em dat oppressed u:

N y’all have dis day rejected ur God, who himself saved u out of all ur adversities N ur tribulations; N y’all have said 2 him, no, but set a king over us. Now therefore present y’all before tha LORD by ur tribes, N by ur thousands.
N when Samuel had caused all tha tribes of Israel 2 come near, tha tribe of Benjamin was taken.
When he had caused tha tribe of Benjamin 2 come near by their families, tha family of Matri was taken, N Saul tha son of Kish was taken: N when dey sought him, he could not be found.
Therefore dey enquired of tha LORD further, if tha man should yet come there. N tha LORD answered, look, he has hid himself among tha stuff.
N dey ran N fetched him thence: N when he stood among tha people, he was higher than any of tha people from his shoulders N upward.
N Samuel said 2 all tha people, See y’all him whom tha LORD has chosen, dat there is none like him among all tha people? N all tha people shouted, N said, God save tha king.
Then Samuel told tha people tha manner of tha kingdom, N wrote it in a book, N laid it up before tha LORD. N Samuel sent all tha people away, every man 2 his house.
N Saul also went home 2 Gibeah; N there went wit him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.
But tha children of Belial said, How shall dis man save us? N dey despised him, N brought him no presents. But he held his peace.

11.text: Then Nahash tha Ammonite came up, N encamped against Jabesh-gilead: N all tha men of Jabesh said 2 Nahash, Make a covenant wit us, N we will serve u.
N Nahash tha Ammonite answered ’em, On dis condition will I make a covenant wit u, dat I may thrust out all ur right eyes, N lay it 4 a reproach upon all Israel.
N tha elders of Jabesh said 2 him, Give us seven days’ respite, dat we may send messengers 2 all tha coasts of Israel: N then, if there be no man 2 save us, we will come out 2 u.
Then came tha messengers 2 Gibeah of Saul, N told tha tidings in tha ears of tha people: N all tha people raised their voices, N wept.
N, look, Saul came after tha herd out of tha field; N Saul said, What ails tha people dat dey weep? N dey told him tha tidings of tha men of Jabesh.
N tha Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard dose tidings, N his anger was kindled greatly.

N he took a yoke of oxen, N hewed ’em in pieces, N sent ’em throughout all tha coasts of Israel by tha hands of messengers, sayin, whoever comes not forth after Saul N after Samuel, so shall it be done 2 his oxen. N tha fear of tha LORD fell on tha people, N dey came out wit one consent.
N when he numbered ’em in Bezek, tha children of Israel were three hundred thousand, N tha men of Judah thirty thousand.

N dey said 2 tha messengers dat came, like dis shall y’all say 2 tha men of Jabesh-gilead, 2 morrow, by dat time tha sun be hot, y’all shall have help. N tha messengers came N showed it 2 tha men of Jabesh; N dey were glad.
Therefore tha men of Jabesh said, 2 morrow we will come out 2 u, N y’all shall do wit us all dat seems good 2 u.

N it was so on tha morrow, dat Saul put tha people in three companies; N dey came in2 tha midst of tha host in tha morning watch, N killed tha Ammonites until tha heat of tha day: N it happened, dat dey which remained were scattered, so dat two of ’em were not left together.
N tha people said 2 Samuel, Who is he dat said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring tha men, dat we may put ’em 2 death.
N Saul said, There shall not a man be put 2 death dis day: 4 2 day tha LORD has wrought salvation in Israel.
Then said Samuel 2 tha people, Come, N let us go 2 Gilgal, N renew tha kingdom there.

N all tha people went 2 Gilgal; N there dey made Saul king before tha LORD in Gilgal; N there dey sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before tha LORD; N there Saul N all tha men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

12.text: N Samuel said 2 all Israel, look, I have listened 2 ur voice in all dat y’all said 2 me, N have made a king over u.
N now, look, tha king walks before u: N I am old N grayheaded; N, look, my sons r wit u: N I have walked before u from my childhood 2 dis day.

Look, here I am: witness against me before tha LORD, N before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received any bribe 2 blind my eyes wit it? N I will restore it u.
N dey said, u have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have u taken ought of any man’s hand.
N he said 2 ’em, tha LORD is witness against u, N his anointed is witness dis day, dat y’all have not found ought in my hand. N dey answered, He is witness.
N Samuel said 2 tha people, It is tha LORD dat advanced Moses N Aaron, N dat brought ur fathers up out of tha land of Egypt.
Now therefore stand still, dat I may reason wit u before tha LORD of all tha righteous acts of tha LORD, which he did 2 u N 2 ur fathers.
When Jacob was come in2 Egypt, N ur fathers cried 2 tha LORD, then tha LORD sent Moses N Aaron, which brought forth ur fathers out of Egypt, N made ’em live in dis place.

N when dey forgat tha LORD their God, he sold ’em in2 tha hand of Sisera, captain of tha host of Hazor, N in2 tha hand of tha Philistines, N in2 tha hand of tha king of Moab, N dey fought against ’em.
N dey cried 2 tha LORD, N said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken tha LORD, N have served Baalim N Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of tha hand of our opps, N we will serve u.
N tha LORD sent Jerubbaal, N Bedan, N Jephthah, N Samuel, N delivered u out of tha hand of ur opps on every side, N y’all dwelled safe.
N when y’all saw dat Nahash tha king of tha children of Ammon came against u, y’all said 2 me, no; but a king shall reign over us: when tha LORD ur God was ur king.
Now therefore look tha king whom y’all have chosen, N whom y’all have desired! N, look, tha LORD has set a king over u.
If y’all will fear tha LORD, N serve him, N obey his voice, N not rebel against tha commandment of tha LORD, then shall both y’all N also tha king dat reigns over u continue followin tha LORD ur God:
But if y’all will not obey tha voice of tha LORD, but rebel against tha commandment of tha LORD, then shall tha hand of tha LORD be against u, as it was against ur fathers.
Now therefore stand N see dis great thing, which tha LORD will do before ur eyes.

Is it not wheat harvest 2 day? I will call 2 tha LORD, N he shall send thunder N rain; dat y’all may perceive N see dat ur wickedness is great, which y’all have done in tha sight of tha LORD, in asking u a king.
So Samuel called 2 tha LORD; N tha LORD sent thunder N rain dat day: N all tha people greatly feared tha LORD N Samuel.
N all tha people said 2 Samuel, Pray 4 ur servants 2 tha LORD ur God, dat we die not: 4 we have added 2 all our sins dis evil, 2 ask us a king.
N Samuel said 2 tha people, don’t fear: y’all have done all dis wickedness: yet turn not aside from followin tha LORD, but serve tha LORD wit all ur heart;
N turn y’all not aside: 4 then should y’all go after vain things, which cannot profit nor deliver; 4 dey r vain.
4 tha LORD will not forsake his people 4 his great name’s sake: because it has pleased tha LORD 2 make u his people.
Moreover as 4 me, God forbid dat I should sin against tha LORD in ceasing 2 pray 4 u: but I will teach u tha good N tha right way:
Only fear tha LORD, N serve him in truth wit all ur heart: 4 consider how great things he has done 4 u.
But if y’all shall still do wickedly, y’all shall be consumed, both y’all N ur king.

13.text: Saul reigned one year; N when he had reigned two years over Israel,

Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were wit Saul in Michmash N in mount Beth-el, N a thousand were wit Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: N tha rest of tha people he sent every man 2 his tent.
N Jonathan struck tha garrison of tha Philistines dat was in Geba, N tha Philistines heard of it. N Saul blew tha trumpet throughout all tha land, sayin, Let tha Hebrews hear.
N all Israel heard say dat Saul had struck a garrison of tha Philistines, N dat Israel also was had in abomination wit tha Philistines. N tha people were called together after Saul 2 Gilgal.

N tha Philistines gathered themselves together 2 fight wit Israel, thirty thousand chariots, N six thousand horsemen, N people as tha sand which is on tha sea shore in crowd: N dey came up, N pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.
When tha men of Israel saw dat dey were in a strait, (4 tha people were distressed,) then tha people did hide themselves in caves, N in thickets, N in rocks, N in high places, N in pits.
N some of tha Hebrews went over Jordan 2 tha land of Gad N Gilead. As 4 Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, N all tha people followed him tremblin.
N he tarried seven days, according 2 tha set time dat Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not 2 Gilgal; N tha people were scattered from him.
N Saul said, Bring here a burnt offering 2 me, N peace offerings. N he offered tha burnt offering.
N it happened, dat as soon as he had made an end of offering tha burnt offering, look, Samuel came; N Saul went out 2 meet him, dat he might greet him.

N Samuel said, What have u done? N Saul said, Because I saw dat tha people were scattered from me, N dat u came not within tha days appointed, N dat tha Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;
Therefore said I, tha Philistines will come down now upon me 2 Gilgal, N I have not made supplication 2 tha LORD: I forced myself therefore, N offered a burnt offering.
N Samuel said 2 Saul, u have done foolishly: u have not kept tha commandment of tha LORD ur God, which he commanded u: 4 now would tha LORD have established ur kingdom upon Israel 4 ever.

But now ur kingdom shall not continue: tha LORD has sought him a man after his own heart, N tha LORD has commanded him 2 be captain over his people, because u have not kept dat which tha LORD commanded u.
N Samuel arose, N got him up from Gilgal 2 Gibeah of Benjamin. N Saul numbered tha people dat were present wit him, about six hundred men.
N Saul, N Jonathan his son, N tha people dat were present wit ’em, stayed in Gibeah of Benjamin: but tha Philistines encamped in Michmash.
N tha spoilers came out of tha camp of tha Philistines in three companies: one company turned 2 tha way dat leads 2 Ophrah, 2 tha land of Shual:
N another company turned tha way 2 Beth-horon: N another company turned 2 tha way of tha border dat looks 2 tha valley of Zeboim toward tha wilderness.
Now there was no smith found throughout all tha land of Israel: 4 tha Philistines said, Lest tha Hebrews make ’em swords or spears:
But all tha Israelites went down 2 tha Philistines, 2 sharpen every man his share, N his coulter, N his axe, N his mattock.
Yet dey had a file 4 tha mattocks, N 4 tha coulters, N 4 tha forks, N 4 tha axes, N 2 sharpen tha goads.
So it happened in tha day of battle, dat there was neither sword nor spear found in tha hand of any of tha people dat were wit Saul N Jonathan: but wit Saul N wit Jonathan his son was there found.
N tha garrison of tha Philistines went out 2 tha passage of Michmash.

14.text: Now it happened upon a day, dat Jonathan tha son of Saul said 2 tha young man dat bare his armour, Come, N let us go over 2 tha Philistines’ garrison, dat is on tha other side. But he told not his father.
N Saul tarried in tha uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: N tha people dat were wit him were about six hundred men;
N Ahiah, tha son of Ahitub, I-chabod’s brother, tha son of Phinehas, tha son of Eli, tha LORD’s priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. N tha people knew not dat Jonathan was gone.

N between tha passages, by which Jonathan sought 2 go over 2 tha Philistines’ garrison, there was a sharp rock on tha one side, N a sharp rock on tha other side: N tha name of tha one was Bozez, N tha name of tha other Seneh.
Tha forefront of tha one was situate northward over against Michmash, N tha other southward over against Gibeah.

N Jonathan said 2 tha young man dat bare his armour, Come, N let us go over 2 tha garrison of dese uncircumcised: it may be dat tha LORD will work 4 us: 4 there is no restraint 2 tha LORD 2 save by many or by few.
N his armourbearer said 2 him, Do all dat is in thine heart: turn u; look, I am wit u according 2 ur heart.
Then said Jonathan, look, we will pass over 2 dese men, N we will discover ourselves 2 ’em.
If dey say like dis 2 us, Tarry until we come 2 u; then we will stand still in our place, N will not go up 2 ’em.
But if dey say like dis, Come up 2 us; then we will go up: 4 tha LORD has delivered ’em in2 our hand: N dis shall be a sign 2 us.
N both of ’em discovered themselves 2 tha garrison of tha Philistines: N tha Philistines said, look, tha Hebrews come forth out of tha holes where dey had hid themselves.

N tha men of tha garrison answered Jonathan N his armourbearer, N said, Come up 2 us, N we will show u a thing. N Jonathan said 2 his armourbearer, Come up after me: 4 tha LORD has delivered ’em in2 tha hand of Israel.
N Jonathan climbed up upon his hands N upon his feet, N his armourbearer after him: N dey fell before Jonathan; N his armourbearer killed after him.
N dat first slaughter, which Jonathan N his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.
N there was tremblin in tha host, in tha field, N among all tha people: tha garrison, N tha spoilers, dey also trembled, N tha earth quaked: so it was a very great tremblin.
N tha watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; N, look, tha crowd melted away, N dey went on beating down one another.
Then said Saul 2 tha people dat were wit him, Number now, N see who is gone from us. N when dey had numbered, look, Jonathan N his armourbearer were not there.
N Saul said 2 Ahiah, Bring here tha ark of God. 4 tha ark of God was at dat time wit tha children of Israel.
N it happened, while Saul talked 2 tha priest, dat tha noise dat was in tha host of tha Philistines went on N increased: N Saul said 2 tha priest, Withdraw thine hand.
N Saul N all tha people dat were wit him assembled themselves, N dey came 2 tha battle: N, look, every man’s sword was against his fellow, N there was a very great discomfiture.

Moreover tha Hebrews dat were wit tha Philistines before dat time, which went up wit ’em in2 tha camp from tha country round about, even dey also turned 2 be wit tha Israelites dat were wit Saul N Jonathan.
Likewise all tha men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when dey heard dat tha Philistines fled, even dey also followed hard after ’em in tha battle.
So tha LORD saved Israel dat day: N tha battle passed over 2 Beth-aven.

N tha men of Israel were distressed dat day: 4 Saul had adjured tha people, sayin, Cursed be tha man dat eats any food until evening, dat I may be avenged on mine opps. So none of tha people tasted any food.
N all dey of tha land came 2 a wood; N there was honey upon tha ground.
N when tha people were come in2 tha wood, look, tha honey dropped; but no man put his hand 2 his mouth: 4 tha people feared tha oath.

But Jonathan heard not when his father charged tha people wit tha oath: so he put forth tha end of tha rod dat was in his hand, N dipped it in an honeycomb, N put his hand 2 his mouth; N his eyes were enlightened.
Then answered one of tha people, N said, ur father straitly charged tha people wit an oath, sayin, Cursed be tha man dat eats any food dis day. N tha people were faint.
Then said Jonathan, My father has troubled tha land: see, I pray u, how my eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of dis honey.
How much more, if maybe tha people had eaten freely 2 day of tha spoil of their opps which dey found? 4 had there not been now a much greater slaughter among tha Philistines?
N dey struck tha Philistines dat day from Michmash 2 Aijalon: N tha people were very faint.
N tha people flew upon tha spoil, N took sheep, N oxen, N calves, N killed ’em on tha ground: N tha people did eat ’em wit tha blood.
Then dey told Saul, sayin, look, tha people sin against tha LORD, in dat dey eat wit tha blood. N he said, y’all have transgressed: roll a great stone 2 me dis day.

N Saul said, Disperse y’all among tha people, N say 2 ’em, Bring me here every man his ox, N every man his sheep, N kill ’em here, N eat; N sin not against tha LORD in eatin wit tha blood. N all tha people brought every man his ox wit him dat night, N killed ’em there.
N Saul built an altar 2 tha LORD: tha same was tha first altar dat he built 2 tha LORD.

N Saul said, Let us go down after tha Philistines by night, N spoil ’em until tha morning light, N let us not leave a man of ’em. N dey said, Do whatever seems good 2 u. Then said tha priest, Let us draw near here 2 God.
N Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after tha Philistines? will u deliver ’em in2 tha hand of Israel? But he answered him not dat day.
N Saul said, Draw y’all near here, all tha chief of tha people: N know N see in which dis sin has been dis day.
4, as tha LORD lives, which saves Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all tha people dat answered him.
Then said he 2 all Israel, Be y’all on one side, N I N Jonathan my son will be on tha other side. N tha people said 2 Saul, Do what seems good 2 u.
Therefore Saul said 2 tha LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect lot. N Saul N Jonathan were taken: but tha people escaped.
N Saul said, Cast lots between me N Jonathan my son. N Jonathan was taken.
Then Saul said 2 Jonathan, Tell me what u have done. N Jonathan told him, N said, I did but taste a little honey wit tha end of tha rod dat was in mine hand, N, look, I must die.
N Saul answered, God do so N more also: 4 u will surely die, Jonathan.

N tha people said 2 Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who has wrought dis great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as tha LORD lives, there shall not one hair of his head fall 2 tha ground; 4 he has wrought wit God dis day. So tha people rescued Jonathan, dat he died not.
Then Saul went up from followin tha Philistines: N tha Philistines went 2 their own place.

So Saul took tha kingdom over Israel, N fought against all his opps on every side, against Moab, N against tha children of Ammon, N against Edom, N against tha kings of Zobah, N against tha Philistines: N wherever he turned himself, he vexed ’em.
N he gathered an host, N struck tha Amalekites, N delivered Israel out of tha hands of ’em dat spoiled ’em.
Now tha sons of Saul were Jonathan, N Ishui, N Melchi-shua: N tha namez of his two daughters were dese; tha name of tha firstborn Merab, N tha name of tha younger Michal:
N tha name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam, tha daughter of Ahimaaz: N tha name of tha captain of his host was Abner, tha son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.
N Kish was tha father of Saul; N Ner tha father of Abner was tha son of Abiel.
N there was sore war against tha Philistines all tha days of Saul: N when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him 2 him.

15.text: Samuel also said 2 Saul, tha LORD sent me 2 anoint u 2 be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore listen u 2 tha voice of tha words of tha LORD.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts, I remember dat which Amalek did 2 Israel, how he laid wait 4 him in tha way, when he came up from Egypt.
Now go N strike Amalek, N utterly destroy all dat dey have, N spare ’em not; but kill both man N woman, infant N suckling, ox N sheep, camel N ass.
N Saul gathered tha people together, N numbered ’em in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, N ten thousand men of Judah.
N Saul came 2 a city of Amalek, N laid wait in tha valley.

N Saul said 2 tha Kenites, Go, depart, get u down from among tha Amalekites, lest I destroy u wit ’em: 4 y’all showed kindness 2 all tha children of Israel, when dey came up out of Egypt. So tha Kenites departed from among tha Amalekites.
N Saul struck tha Amalekites from Havilah until u come 2 Shur, dat is over against Egypt.
N he took Agag tha king of tha Amalekites alive, N utterly destroyed all tha people wit tha edge of tha sword.

But Saul N tha people spared Agag, N tha best of tha sheep, N of tha oxen, N of tha fatlings, N tha lambs, N all dat was good, N would not utterly destroy ’em: but every thing dat was vile N refuse, dat dey destroyed utterly.
Then came tha word of tha LORD 2 Samuel, sayin,
It repenteth me dat I have set up Saul 2 be king: 4 he is turned back from followin me, N has not performed my commandments. N it grieved Samuel; N he cried 2 tha LORD all night.
N when Samuel rose early 2 meet Saul in tha morning, it was told Samuel, sayin, Saul came 2 Carmel, N, look, he set him up a place, N is gone about, N passed on, N gone down 2 Gilgal.
N Samuel came 2 Saul: N Saul said 2 him, Blessed be u of tha LORD: I have performed tha commandment of tha LORD.
N Samuel said, What means then dis bleating of tha sheep in mine ears, N tha lowing of tha oxen which I hear?
N Saul said, dey have brought ’em from tha Amalekites: 4 tha people spared tha best of tha sheep N of tha oxen, 2 sacrifice 2 tha LORD ur God; N tha rest we have utterly destroyed.

N Samuel said, When u were little in ur own sight, were u not made tha head of tha tribes of Israel, N tha LORD anointed u king over Israel?
N tha LORD sent u on a journey, N said, Go N utterly destroy tha sinners tha Amalekites, N fight against ’em until dey be consumed.
So then did u not obey tha voice of tha LORD, but did fly upon tha spoil, N did evil in tha sight of tha LORD?
N Saul said 2 Samuel, yeah, I have obeyed tha voice of tha LORD, N have gone tha way which tha LORD sent me, N have brought Agag tha king of Amalek, N have utterly destroyed tha Amalekites.
But tha people took of tha spoil, sheep N oxen, tha chief of tha things which should have been utterly destroyed, 2 sacrifice 2 tha LORD ur God in Gilgal.
N Samuel said, has tha LORD as great delight in burnt offerings N sacrifices, as in obeying tha voice of tha LORD? look, 2 obey is better than sacrifice, N 2 listen than tha fat of rams.
4 rebellion is as tha sin of witchcraft, N stubbornness is as iniquity N idolatry. Because u have rejected tha word of tha LORD, he has also rejected u from bein king.
N Saul said 2 Samuel, I have sinned: 4 I have transgressed tha commandment of tha LORD, N ur words: because I feared tha people, N obeyed their voice.
Now therefore, I pray u, pardon my sin, N turn again wit me, dat I may worship tha LORD.
N Samuel said 2 Saul, I will not return wit u: 4 u have rejected tha word of tha LORD, N tha LORD has rejected u from bein king over Israel.
N as Samuel turned about 2 go away, he laid hold upon tha skirt of his mantle, N it rent.
N Samuel said 2 him, tha LORD has rent tha kingdom of Israel from u dis day, N has given it 2 a neighbour of thine, dat is better than u.
N also tha Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: 4 he is not a man, dat he should repent.
Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray u, before tha elders of my people, N before Israel, N turn again wit me, dat I may worship tha LORD ur God.
So Samuel turned again after Saul; N Saul worshipped tha LORD.
Then said Samuel, Bring y’all here 2 me Agag tha king of tha Amalekites. N Agag came 2 him delicately. N Agag said, Surely tha bitterness of death is past.
N Samuel said, As ur sword has made women childless, so shall ur mother be childless among women. N Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before tha LORD in Gilgal.
Then Samuel went 2 Ramah; N Saul went up 2 his house 2 Gibeah of Saul.
N Samuel came no more 2 see Saul until tha day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned 4 Saul: N tha LORD repented dat he had made Saul king over Israel.

16.text: N tha LORD said 2 Samuel, How long will u mourn 4 Saul, seein I have rejected him from reignin over Israel? fill thine horn wit oil, N go, I will send u 2 Jesse tha Beth-lehemite: 4 I have provided me a king among his sons.
N Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he will kill me. N tha LORD said, Take an heifer wit u, N say, I am come 2 sacrifice 2 tha LORD.
N call Jesse 2 tha sacrifice, N I will show u what u will do: N u will anoint 2 me him whom I name 2 u.
N Samuel did dat which tha LORD spoke, N came 2 Beth-lehem. N tha elders of tha town trembled at his comin, N said, come u peaceably?
N he said, Peaceably: I am come 2 sacrifice 2 tha LORD: sanctify y’all, N come wit me 2 tha sacrifice. N he sanctified Jesse N his sons, N called ’em 2 tha sacrifice.
N it happened, when dey were come, dat he looked on Eliab, N said, Surely tha LORD’s anointed is before him.

But tha LORD said 2 Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on tha height of his stature; because I have refused him: 4 tha Lord sees not as man sees; 4 man looks on tha outward appearance, but tha LORD looks on tha heart.
Then Jesse called Abinadab, N made him pass before Samuel. N he said, Neither has tha LORD chosen dis.

Again, Jesse made seven of his sons 2 pass before Samuel. N Samuel said 2 Jesse, tha LORD has not chosen dese.

N Samuel said 2 Jesse, r here all ur children? N he said, There remains yet tha youngest, N, look, he keeps tha sheep. N Samuel said 2 Jesse, Send N fetch him: 4 we will not sit down till he come here.
N he sent, N brought him in. Now he was ruddy, N withal of a beautiful countenance, N goodly 2 look 2. N tha LORD said, Arise, anoint him: 4 dis is he.
Then Samuel took tha horn of oil, N anointed him in tha midst of his brothers: N tha Spirit of tha LORD came upon David from dat day forward. So Samuel rose up, N went 2 Ramah.
But tha Spirit of tha LORD departed from Saul, N an evil spirit from tha LORD troubled him.
N Saul’s servants said 2 him, look now, an evil spirit from God troubles u.

Let our lord now command ur servants, which r before u, 2 seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: N it will happen, when tha evil spirit from God is upon u, dat he shall play wit his hand, N u will be well.
N Saul said 2 his servants, Provide me now a man dat can play well, N bring him 2 me.

Then answered one of tha servants, N said, look, I have seen a son of Jesse tha Beth-lehemite, dat is cunning in playing, N a mighty valiant man, N a man of war, N prudent in matters, N a comely person, N tha LORD is wit him.
So Saul sent messengers 2 Jesse, N said, Send me David ur son, which is wit tha sheep.
N Jesse took an ass laden wit bread, N a bottle of wine, N a kid, N sent ’em by David his son 2 Saul.
N David came 2 Saul, N stood before him: N he loved him greatly; N he became his armourbearer.
N Saul sent 2 Jesse, sayin, Let David, I pray u, stand before me; 4 he has found favour in my sight.

17.text: Now tha Philistines gathered together their armies 2 battle, N were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongs 2 Judah, N pitched between Shochoh N Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.
N Saul N tha men of Israel were gathered together, N pitched by tha valley of Elah, N set tha battle in array against tha Philistines.
N tha Philistines stood on a mountain on tha one side, N Israel stood on a mountain on tha other side: N there was a valley between ’em.
N there went out a champion out of tha camp of tha Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits N a span.
N he had an helmet of brass upon his head, N he was armed wit a coat of mail; N tha weight of tha coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
N he had greaves of brass upon his legs, N a target of brass between his shoulders.
N tha staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; N his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: N one bearin a shield went before him.
N he stood N cried 2 tha armies of Israel, N said 2 ’em, Why r y’all come out 2 set ur battle in array? am not I a Philistine, N y’all servants 2 Saul? choose u a man 4 u, N let him come down 2 me.
If he be able 2 fight wit me, N 2 kill me, then will we be ur servants: but if I prevail against him, N kill him, then shall y’all be our servants, N serve us.
N tha Philistine said, I defy tha armies of Israel dis day; give me a man, dat we may fight together.
When Saul N all Israel heard dose words of tha Philistine, dey were dismayed, N greatly afraid.
Now David was tha son of dat Ephrathite of Beth-lehem-judah, whose name was Jesse; N he had eight sons: N tha man went among men 4 an old man in tha days of Saul.
N tha three eldest sons of Jesse went N followed Saul 2 tha battle: N tha namez of his three sons dat went 2 tha battle were Eliab tha firstborn, N next 2 him Abinadab, N tha third Shammah.
N David was tha youngest: N tha three eldest followed Saul.
But David went N returned from Saul 2 feed his father’s sheep at Beth-lehem.
N tha Philistine drew near morning N evening, N presented himself forty days.
N Jesse said 2 David his son, Take now 4 ur brothers an ephah of dis parched corn, N dese ten loaves, N run 2 tha camp 2 ur brothers;
N carry dese ten cheeses 2 tha captain of their thousand, N look how ur brothers fare, N take their pledge.
Now Saul, N dey, N all tha men of Israel, were in tha valley of Elah, fightin wit tha Philistines.

N David rose up early in tha morning, N left tha sheep wit a keeper, N took, N went, as Jesse had commanded him; N he came 2 tha trench, as tha host was goin forth 2 tha fight, N shouted 4 tha battle.
4 Israel N tha Philistines had put tha battle in array, army against army.
N David left his carriage in tha hand of tha keeper of tha carriage, N ran in2 tha army, N came N greeted his brothers.
N as he talked wit ’em, look, there came up tha champion, tha Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of tha armies of tha Philistines, N spoke according 2 tha same words: N David heard ’em.
N all tha men of Israel, when dey saw tha man, fled from him, N were sore afraid.

N tha men of Israel said, Have y’all seen dis man dat is come up? surely 2 defy Israel is he come up: N it will be, dat tha man who kills him, tha king will enrich him wit great riches, N will give him his daughter, N make his father’s house free in Israel.

N David spoke 2 tha men dat stood by him, sayin, What shall be done 2 tha man dat kills dis Philistine, N takes away tha reproach from Israel? 4 who is dis uncircumcised Philistine, dat he should defy tha armies of tha livin God?
N tha people answered him after dis manner, sayin, So shall it be done 2 tha man dat kills him.

N Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spoke 2 tha men; N Eliab’s anger was kindled against David, N he said, Why came u down here? N wit whom have u left dose few sheep in tha wilderness? I know ur pride, N tha naughtiness of thine heart; 4 u r come down dat u might see tha battle.
N David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?
N he turned from him toward another, N spoke after tha same manner: N tha people answered him again after tha former manner.
N when tha words were heard which David spoke, dey rehearsed ’em before Saul: N he sent 4 him.
N David said 2 Saul, Let no man’s heart fail because of him; ur servant will go N fight wit dis Philistine.
N Saul said 2 David, u r not able 2 go against dis Philistine 2 fight wit him: 4 u r but a youth, N he a man of war from his youth.
N David said 2 Saul, ur servant kept his father’s sheep, N there came a lion, N a bear, N took a lamb out of tha flock:
N I went out after him, N struck him, N delivered it out of his mouth: N when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, N struck him, N killed him.
Ur servant killed both tha lion N tha bear: N dis uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of ’em, seein he has defied tha armies of tha livin God.

David said moreover, tha LORD dat delivered me out of tha paw of tha lion, N out of tha paw of tha bear, he will deliver me out of tha hand of dis Philistine. N Saul said 2 David, Go, N tha LORD be wit u.
N Saul armed David wit his armour, N he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him wit a coat of mail.
N David girded his sword upon his armour, N he assayed 2 go; 4 he had not proved it. N David said 2 Saul, I cannot go wit dese; 4 I have not proved ’em. N David put ’em off him.

N he took his staff in his hand, N chose him five smooth stones out of tha brook, N put ’em in a shepherd’s bag which he had, even in a scrip; N his sling was in his hand: N he drew near 2 tha Philistine.
N tha Philistine came on N drew near 2 David; N tha man dat bare tha shield went before him.
N when tha Philistine looked about, N saw David, he disdained him: 4 he was but a youth, N ruddy, N of a fair countenance.
N tha Philistine said 2 David, Am I a dog, dat u come 2 me wit staves? N tha Philistine cursed David by his gods.
N tha Philistine said 2 David, Come 2 me, N I will give ur flesh 2 tha fowls of tha air, N 2 tha beasts of tha field.
Then said David 2 tha Philistine, u come 2 me wit a sword, N wit a spear, N wit a shield: but I come 2 u in tha name of tha LORD of hosts, tha God of tha armies of Israel, whom u have defied.

Dis day will tha LORD deliver u in2 mine hand; N I will strike u, N take thine head from u; N I will give tha carcases of tha host of tha Philistines dis day 2 tha fowls of tha air, N 2 tha wild beasts of tha earth; dat all tha earth may know dat there is a God in Israel.

N it happened, when tha Philistine arose, N came N drew nigh 2 meet David, dat David hasted, N ran toward tha army 2 meet tha Philistine.

Therefore David ran, N stood upon tha Philistine, N took his sword, N drew it out of tha sheath of it, N killed him, N cut off his head wit it. N when tha Philistines saw their champion was dead, dey fled.

N tha men of Israel N of Judah arose, N shouted, N pursued tha Philistines, until u come 2 tha valley, N 2 tha gates of Ekron. N tha wounded of tha Philistines fell down by tha way 2 Shaaraim, even 2 Gath, N 2 Ekron.

N David took tha head of tha Philistine, N brought it 2 Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.
N when Saul saw David go forth against tha Philistine, he said 2 Abner, tha captain of tha host, Abner, whose son is dis youth? N Abner said, As ur soul lives, O king, I cannot tell.
N tha king said, Enquire u whose son tha stripling is.

N Saul said 2 him, Whose son r u, u young man? N David answered, I am tha son of ur servant Jesse tha Beth-lehemite.

18.text: N it happened, when he had made an end of speakin 2 Saul, dat tha soul of Jonathan was knit wit tha soul of David, N Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

N Saul eyed David from dat day N forward.

N it happened on tha morrow, dat tha evil spirit from God came upon Saul, N he prophesied in tha midst of tha house: N David played wit his hand, as at other times: N there was a javelin in Saul’s hand.
N Saul cast tha javelin; 4 he said, I will strike David even 2 tha wall wit it. N David avoided out of his presence twice.
N Saul was afraid of David, because tha LORD was wit him, N was departed from Saul.
Therefore Saul removed him from him, N made him his captain over a thousand; N he went out N came in before tha people.

So when Saul saw dat he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.
But all Israel N Judah loved David, because he went out N came in before ’em.

N Saul said 2 David, look my elder daughter Merab, her will I give u 2 wife: only be u valiant 4 me, N fight tha LORD’s battles. 4 Saul said, don’t let mine hand be upon him, but let tha hand of tha Philistines be upon him.

But it happened at tha time when Merab Saul’s daughter should have been given 2 David, dat she was given 2 Adriel tha Meholathite 2 wife.
N Michal Saul’s daughter loved David: N dey told Saul, N tha thing pleased him.
N Saul said, I will give him her, dat she may be a snare 2 him, N dat tha hand of tha Philistines may be against him. so Saul said 2 David, u will dis day be my son in law in tha one of tha twain.
N Saul commanded his servants, sayin, Commune wit David secretly, N say, look, tha king has delight in u, N all his servants love u: now therefore be tha king’s son in law.
N Saul’s servants spoke dose words in tha ears of David. N David said, seems it 2 u a light thing 2 be a king’s son in law, seein dat I am a poor man, N lightly esteemed?
N tha servants of Saul told him, sayin, On dis manner spoke David.

N Saul said, like dis shall y’all say 2 David, tha king desires not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of tha Philistines, 2 be avenged of tha king’s opps. But Saul thought 2 make David fall by tha hand of tha Philistines.
N when his servants told David dese words, it pleased David well 2 be tha king’s son in law: N tha days were not expired.

So David arose N went, he N his men, N killed of tha Philistines two hundred men; N David brought their foreskins, N dey gave ’em in full tale 2 tha king, dat he might be tha king’s son in law. N Saul gave him Michal his daughter 2 wife.
N Saul saw N knew dat tha LORD was wit David, N dat Michal Saul’s daughter loved him.
N Saul was yet tha more afraid of David; N Saul became David’s opp continually.
Then tha princes of tha Philistines went forth: N it happened, after dey went forth, dat David behaved himself more wisely than all tha servants of Saul; so dat his name was much set by.

19.text: N Saul spoke 2 Jonathan his son, N 2 all his servants, dat dey should kill David.

But Jonathan Saul’s son delighted much in David: N Jonathan told David, sayin, Saul my father seeks 2 kill u: now therefore, I pray u, pay attention 2 urself until tha morning, N abide in a secret place, N hide urself:
N I will go out N stand beside my father in tha field where u r, N I will commune wit my father of u; N what I see, dat I will tell u.

N Jonathan spoke good of David 2 Saul his father, N said 2 him, don’t let tha king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against u, N because his works have been 2 u-ward very good:

4 he did put his life in his hand, N killed tha Philistine, N tha LORD wrought a great salvation 4 all Israel: u saw it, N did rejoice: so then will u sin against innocent blood, 2 kill David without a cause?

N there was war again: N David went out, N fought wit tha Philistines, N killed ’em wit a great slaughter; N dey fled from him.

N Saul sought 2 strike David even 2 tha wall wit tha javelin; but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence, N he struck tha javelin in2 tha wall: N David fled, N escaped dat night.

N Michal took an image, N laid it in tha bed, N put a pillow of goats’ hair 4 his bolster, N covered it wit a cloth.

N Saul said 2 Michal, Why have u deceived me so, N sent away mine opp, dat he is escaped? N Michal answered Saul, He said 2 me, Let me go; why should I kill u?
So David fled, N escaped, N came 2 Samuel 2 Ramah, N told him all dat Saul had done 2 him. N he N Samuel went N lived in Naioth.
N it was told Saul, sayin, look, David is at Naioth in Ramah.

N Saul sent messengers 2 take David: N when dey saw tha company of tha prophets prophesying, N Samuel standin as appointed over ’em, tha Spirit of God was upon tha messengers of Saul, N dey also prophesied.

Then went he also 2 Ramah, N came 2 a great well dat is in Sechu: N he asked N said, Where r Samuel N David? N one said, look, dey be at Naioth in Ramah.
N he went there 2 Naioth in Ramah: N tha Spirit of God was upon him also, N he went on, N prophesied, until he came 2 Naioth in Ramah.

20.text: N David fled from Naioth in Ramah, N came N said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? N what is my sin before ur father, dat he seeks my life?
N he said 2 him, God forbid; u will not die: look, my father will do nothing either great or small, but dat he will show it me: N why should my father hide dis thing from me? it is not so.

N David sware moreover, N said, ur father certainly knows dat I have found grace in ur eyes; N he says, don’t let Jonathan know dis, lest he be grieved: but truly as tha LORD lives, N as ur soul lives, there is but a step between me N death.
