N David said 2 Jonathan, look, 2 morrow is tha new moon, N I should not fail 2 sit wit tha king at food: but let me go, dat I may hide myself in tha field 2 tha third day at even.
If ur father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me dat he might run 2 Beth-lehem his city: 4 there is a yearly sacrifice there 4 all tha family.
If he say like dis, It is well; ur servant shall have peace: but if he be very angry, then be sure dat evil is determined by him.
Therefore u will deal kindly wit ur servant; 4 u have brought ur servant in2 a covenant of tha LORD wit u: even so, if there be in me iniquity, kill me urself; 4 why should u bring me 2 ur father?
N Jonathan said, Far be it from u: 4 if I knew certainly dat evil were determined by my father 2 come upon u, then would not I tell it u?
Then said David 2 Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if ur father answer u roughly?
N Jonathan said 2 David, Come, N let us go out in2 tha field. N dey went out both of ’em in2 tha field.
N Jonathan said 2 David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about 2 morrow any time, or tha third day, N, look, if there be good toward David, N I then send not 2 u, N show it u;
Tha LORD do so N much more 2 Jonathan: but if it please my father 2 do u evil, then I will show it u, N send u away, dat u may go in peace: N tha LORD be wit u, as he has been wit my father.
N u will not only while yet I live show me tha kindness of tha LORD, dat I die not:
But also u will not cut off ur kindness from my house 4 ever: no, not when tha LORD has cut off tha opps of David every one from tha face of tha earth.
So Jonathan made a covenant wit tha house of David, sayin, Let tha LORD even require it at tha hand of David’s opps.
N Jonathan caused David 2 swear again, because he loved him: 4 he loved him as he loved his own soul.
Then Jonathan said 2 David, 2 morrow is tha new moon: N u will be missed, because ur seat will be empty.
N when u have stayed three days, then u will go down quickly, N come 2 tha place where u did hide urself when tha business was in hand, N will remain by tha stone Ezel.
N I will shoot three arrows on tha side of it, as though I shot at a mark.

N, look, I will send a lad, sayin, Go, find out tha arrows. If I expressly say 2 tha lad, look, tha arrows r on dis side of u, take ’em; then come u: 4 there is peace 2 u, N no hurt; as tha LORD lives.
But if I say like dis 2 tha young man, look, tha arrows r beyond u; go ur way: 4 tha LORD has sent u away.
N as touching tha matter which u N I have spoken of, look, tha LORD be between u N me 4 ever.
So David hid himself in tha field: N when tha new moon was come, tha king sat him down 2 eat food.
N tha king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by tha wall: N Jonathan arose, N Abner sat by Saul’s side, N David’s place was empty.
Nevertheless Saul spoke not any thing dat day: 4 he thought, Something has befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
N it happened on tha morrow, which was tha second day of tha month, dat David’s place was empty: N Saul said 2 Jonathan his son, so comes not tha son of Jesse 2 food, neither yesterday, nor 2 day?
N Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me 2 go 2 Beth-lehem:

N he said, Let me go, I pray u; 4 our family has a sacrifice in tha city; N my brother, he has commanded me 2 be there: N now, if I have found favour in ur eyes, let me get away, I pray u, N see my brothers. Therefore he comes not 2 tha king’s table.

Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, N he said 2 him, u son of tha perverse rebellious woman, do not I know dat u have chosen tha son of Jesse 2 ur own confusion, N 2 tha confusion of ur mother’s nakedness?
4 as long as tha son of Jesse lives upon tha ground, u will not be established, nor ur kingdom. so now send N fetch him 2 me, 4 he shall surely die.
N Jonathan answered Saul his father, N said 2 him, so shall he be killed? what has he done?
N Saul cast a javelin at him 2 strike him: whereby Jonathan knew dat it was determined of his father 2 kill David.
So Jonathan arose from tha table in fierce anger, N did eat no food tha second day of tha month: 4 he was grieved 4 David, because his father had done him shame.
N it happened in tha morning, dat Jonathan went out in2 tha field at tha time appointed wit David, N a little lad wit him.
N he said 2 his lad, Run, find out now tha arrows which I shoot. N as tha lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
N when tha lad was come 2 tha place of tha arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after tha lad, N said, Is not tha arrow beyond u?
N Jonathan cried after tha lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. N Jonathan’s lad gathered up tha arrows, N came 2 his master.
But tha lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan N David knew tha matter.
N Jonathan gave his artillery 2 his lad, N said 2 him, Go, carry ’em 2 tha city.

N as soon as tha lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward tha south, N fell on his face 2 tha ground, N bowed himself three times: N dey kissed one another, N wept one wit another, until David exceeded.

N Jonathan said 2 David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in tha name of tha LORD, sayin, tha LORD be between me N u, N between my seed N ur seed 4 ever. N he arose N departed: N Jonathan went in2 tha city. be witness of dat which etc

21.text: Then came David 2 Nob 2 Ahimelech tha priest: N Ahimelech was afraid at tha meeting of David, N said 2 him, Why r u alone, N no man wit u?

N David said 2 Ahimelech tha priest, tha king has commanded me a business, N has said 2 me, Let no man know any thing of tha business whereabout I send u, N what I have commanded u: N I have appointed my servants 2 such N such a place.
Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.
N tha priest answered David, N said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if tha young men have kept themselves at least from women.

N David answered tha priest, N said 2 him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about dese three days, since I came out, N tha vessels of tha young men r holy, N tha bread is in a manner common, yeah, though it were sanctified dis day in tha vessel.
So tha priest gave him hallowed bread: 4 there was no bread there but tha showbread, dat was taken from before tha LORD, 2 put hot bread in tha day when it was taken away.
Now a certain man of tha servants of Saul was there dat day, detained before tha LORD; N his name was Doeg, an Edomite, tha chiefest of tha herdmen dat belonged 2 Saul.
N David said 2 Ahimelech, N is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? 4 I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons wit me, because tha king’s business required haste.

N tha priest said, tha sword of Goliath tha Philistine, whom u slewest in tha valley of Elah, look, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind tha ephod: if u will take dat, take it: 4 there is no other save dat here. N David said, There is none like dat; give it me.
N David arose, N fled dat day 4 fear of Saul, N went 2 Achish tha king of Gath.
N tha servants of Achish said 2 him, Is not dis David tha king of tha land? did dey not sing one 2 another of him in dances, sayin, Saul has killed his thousands, N David his ten thousands?
N David laid up dese words in his heart, N was sore afraid of Achish tha king of Gath.
N he changed his behaviour before ’em, N feigned himself mad in their hands, N scrabbled on tha doors of tha gate, N let his spittle fall down upon his beard.
Then said Achish 2 his servants, look, y’all see tha man is mad: so then have y’all brought him 2 me?
Have I need of mad men, dat y’all have brought dis fellow 2 play tha mad man in my presence? shall dis fellow come in2 my house?

22.text: David therefore departed thence, N escaped 2 tha cave Adullam: N when his brothers N all his father’s house heard it, dey went down there 2 him.
N every one dat was in distress, N every one dat was in debt, N every one dat was discontented, gathered themselves 2 him; N he became a captain over ’em: N there were wit him about four hundred men.
N David went thence 2 Mizpeh of Moab: N he said 2 tha king of Moab, Let my father N my mother, I pray u, come forth, N be wit u, till I know what God will do 4 me.
N he brought ’em before tha king of Moab: N dey lived wit him all tha while dat David was in tha hold.
N tha prophet Gad said 2 David, Abide not in tha hold; depart, N get u in2 tha land of Judah. Then David departed, N came in2 tha forest of Hareth.
When Saul heard dat David was discovered, N tha men dat were wit him, (now Saul stayed in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, havin his spear in his hand, N all his servants were standin about him;)

Then Saul said 2 his servants dat stood about him, Hear now, y’all Benjamites; will tha son of Jesse give every one of u fields N vineyards, N make u all captains of thousands, N captains of hundreds;

Dat all of u have conspired against me, N there is none dat shows me dat my son has made a league wit tha son of Jesse, N there is none of u dat is sorry 4 me, or shows 2 me dat my son has stirred up my servant against me, 2 lie in wait, as at dis day?
Then answered Doeg tha Edomite, which was set over tha servants of Saul, N said, I saw tha son of Jesse comin 2 Nob, 2 Ahimelech tha son of Ahitub.
N he enquired of tha LORD 4 him, N gave him food, N gave him tha sword of Goliath tha Philistine.
Then tha king sent 2 call Ahimelech tha priest, tha son of Ahitub, N all his father’s house, tha priests dat were in Nob: N dey came all of ’em 2 tha king.
N Saul said, Hear now, u son of Ahitub. N he answered, Here I am, my lord.

N Saul said 2 him, Why have y’all conspired against me, u N tha son of Jesse, in dat u have given him bread, N a sword, N have enquired of God 4 him, dat he should rise against me, 2 lie in wait, as at dis day?
Then Ahimelech answered tha king, N said, N who is so faithful among all ur servants as David, which is tha king’s son in law, N goes at ur bidding, N is honourable in thine house?
Did I then begin 2 enquire of God 4 him? be it far from me: don’t let tha king impute any thing 2 his servant, nor 2 all tha house of my father: 4 ur servant knew nothing of all dis, less or more.
N tha king said, u will surely die, Ahimelech, u, N all ur father’s house.

N tha king said 2 tha footmen dat stood about him, Turn, N kill tha priests of tha LORD; because their hand also is wit David, N because dey knew when he fled, N did not show it 2 me. But tha servants of tha king would not put forth their hand 2 fall upon tha priests of tha LORD.
N tha king said 2 Doeg, Turn u, N fall upon tha priests. N Doeg tha Edomite turned, N he fell upon tha priests, N killed on dat day fourscore N five persons dat did wear a linen ephod.
N Nob, tha city of tha priests, struck he wit tha edge of tha sword, both men N women, children N sucklings, N oxen, N asses, N sheep, wit tha edge of tha sword.
N one of tha sons of Ahimelech tha son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, N fled after David.
N Abiathar showed David dat Saul had killed tha LORD’s priests.
N David said 2 Abiathar, I knew it dat day, when Doeg tha Edomite was there, dat he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned tha death of all tha persons of ur father’s house.
Abide u wit me, don’t fear: 4 he dat seeks my life seeks ur life: but wit me u will be in safeguard.

23.text: Then dey told David, sayin, look, tha Philistines fight against Keilah, N dey rob tha threshingfloors.
Therefore David enquired of tha LORD, sayin, Shall I go N strike dese Philistines? N tha LORD said 2 David, Go, N strike tha Philistines, N save Keilah.
N David’s men said 2 him, look, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come 2 Keilah against tha armies of tha Philistines?
Then David enquired of tha LORD yet again. N tha LORD answered him N said, Arise, go down 2 Keilah; 4 I will deliver tha Philistines in2 thine hand.
So David N his men went 2 Keilah, N fought wit tha Philistines, N brought away their cattle, N struck ’em wit a great slaughter. So David saved tha inhabitants of Keilah.
N it happened, when Abiathar tha son of Ahimelech fled 2 David 2 Keilah, dat he came down wit an ephod in his hand.
N it was told Saul dat David was come 2 Keilah. N Saul said, God has delivered him in2 mine hand; 4 he is shut in, by entering in2 a town dat has gates N bars.
N Saul called all tha people together 2 war, 2 go down 2 Keilah, 2 besiege David N his men.
N David knew dat Saul secretly practised mischief against him; N he said 2 Abiathar tha priest, Bring here tha ephod.
Then said David, O LORD God of Israel, ur servant has certainly heard dat Saul seeks 2 come 2 Keilah, 2 destroy tha city 4 my sake.
Will tha men of Keilah deliver me up in2 his hand? will Saul come down, as ur servant has heard? O LORD God of Israel, I beg u, tell ur servant. N tha LORD said, He will come down.
Then said David, Will tha men of Keilah deliver me N my men in2 tha hand of Saul? N tha LORD said, dey will deliver u up.
Then David N his men, which were about six hundred, arose N departed out of Keilah, N went wherever dey could go. N it was told Saul dat David was escaped from Keilah; N he forbare 2 go forth.
N David stayed in tha wilderness in strong holds, N remained in a mountain in tha wilderness of Ziph. N Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not in2 his hand.
N David saw dat Saul was come out 2 seek his life: N David was in tha wilderness of Ziph in a wood.
N Jonathan Saul’s son arose, N went 2 David in2 tha wood, N strengthened his hand in God.
N he said 2 him, don’t fear: 4 tha hand of Saul my father shall not find u; N u will be king over Israel, N I shall be next 2 u; N dat also Saul my father knows.
N dey two made a covenant before tha LORD: N David stayed in tha wood, N Jonathan went 2 his house.
Then came up tha Ziphites 2 Saul 2 Gibeah, sayin, does not David hide himself wit us in strong holds in tha wood, in tha hill of Hachilah, which is on tha south of Jeshimon?
Now therefore, O king, come down according 2 all tha desire of ur soul 2 come down; N our part shall be 2 deliver him in2 tha king’s hand.
N Saul said, Blessed be y’all of tha LORD; 4 y’all have compassion on me.
Go, I pray u, prepare yet, N know N see his place where his haunt is, N who has seen him there: 4 it is told me dat he deals very subtilly.

See therefore, N take knowledge of all tha lurking places where he hides himself, N come y’all again 2 me wit tha certainty, N I will go wit u: N it will happen, if he be in tha land, dat I will search him out throughout all tha thousands of Judah.
N dey arose, N went 2 Ziph before Saul: but David N his men were in tha wilderness of Maon, in tha plain on tha south of Jeshimon.
Saul also N his men went 2 seek him. N dey told David: so he came down in2 a rock, N stayed in tha wilderness of Maon. N when Saul heard dat, he pursued after David in tha wilderness of Maon.

N Saul went on dis side of tha mountain, N David N his men on dat side of tha mountain: N David made haste 2 get away 4 fear of Saul; 4 Saul N his men compassed David N his men round about 2 take ’em.
But there came a messenger 2 Saul, sayin, Haste u, N come; 4 tha Philistines have invaded tha land.
So Saul returned from pursuing after David, N went against tha Philistines: therefore dey called dat place Sela-hammahlekoth.
N David went up from thence, N lived in strong holds at En-gedi.

24.text: N it happened, when Saul was returned from followin tha Philistines, dat it was told him, sayin, look, David is in tha wilderness of En-gedi.
Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, N went 2 seek David N his men upon tha rocks of tha wild goats.
N he came 2 tha sheepcotes by tha way, where was a cave; N Saul went in 2 cover his feet: N David N his men remained in tha sides of tha cave.

N tha men of David said 2 him, look tha day of which tha LORD said 2 u, look, I will deliver thine opp in2 thine hand, dat u may do 2 him as it shall seem good 2 u. Then David arose, N cut off tha skirt of Saul’s robe privily.
N it happened afterward, dat David’s heart struck him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
N he said 2 his men, tha LORD forbid dat I should do dis thing 2 my master, tha LORD’s anointed, 2 stretch forth mine hand against him, seein he is tha anointed of tha LORD.
So David stayed his servants wit dese words, N suffered ’em not 2 rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of tha cave, N went on his way.
David also arose afterward, N went out of tha cave, N cried after Saul, sayin, My lord tha king. N when Saul looked behind him, David stooped wit his face 2 tha earth, N bowed himself.
N David said 2 Saul, so hear u men’s words, sayin, look, David seeks ur hurt?

Look, dis day ur eyes have seen how dat tha LORD had delivered u 2 day in2 mine hand in tha cave: N some told me kill u: but mine eye spared u; N I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; 4 he is tha LORD’s anointed.

Moreover, my father, see, yeah, see tha skirt of ur robe in my hand: 4 in dat I cut off tha skirt of ur robe, N killed u not, know u N see dat there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, N I have not sinned against u; yet u huntest my soul 2 take it.
Tha LORD judge between me N u, N tha LORD avenge me of u: but mine hand shall not be upon u.
As says tha proverb of tha ancients, Wickedness proceeds from tha wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon u.
After whom is tha king of Israel come out? after whom do u pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.
Tha LORD therefore be judge, N judge between me N u, N see, N plead my cause, N deliver me out of thine hand.
N it happened, when David had made an end of speakin dese words 2 Saul, dat Saul said, Is dis ur voice, my son David? N Saul raised his voice, N wept.
N he said 2 David, u r more righteous than I: 4 u have rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded u evil.
N u have showed dis day how dat u have dealt well wit me: forasmuch as when tha LORD had delivered me in2 thine hand, u killedst me not.
4 if a man find his opp, will he let him go well away? so tha LORD reward u good 4 dat u have done 2 me dis day.
N now, look, I know well dat u will surely be king, N dat tha kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.
Swear now therefore 2 me by tha LORD, dat u will not cut off my seed after me, N dat u will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.
N David sware 2 Saul. N Saul went home; but David N his men got ’em up 2 tha hold.

25.text: N Samuel died; N all tha Israelites were gathered together, N lamented him, N buried him in his house at Ramah. N David arose, N went down 2 tha wilderness of Paran.
N there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; N tha man was very great, N he had three thousand sheep, N a thousand goats: N he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

Now tha name of tha man was Nabal; N tha name of his wife Abigail: N she was a woman of good understanding, N of a beautiful countenance: but tha man was churlish N evil in his doings; N he was of tha house of Caleb.
N David heard in tha wilderness dat Nabal did shear his sheep.
N David sent out ten young men, N David said 2 tha young men, Get u up 2 Carmel, N go 2 Nabal, N greet him in my name:
N like dis shall y’all say 2 him dat lives in prosperity, Peace be both 2 u, N peace be 2 thine house, N peace be 2 all dat u have.
N now I have heard dat u have shearers: now ur shepherds which were wit us, we hurt ’em not, neither was there ought missing 2 ’em, all tha while dey were in Carmel.
Ask ur young men, N dey will show u. so let tha young men find favour in ur eyes: 4 we come in a good day: give, I pray u, whatever comes 2 thine hand 2 ur servants, N 2 ur son David.
N when David’s young men came, dey spoke 2 Nabal according 2 all dose words in tha name of David, N ceased.
N Nabal answered David’s servants, N said, Who is David? N who is tha son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days dat break away every man from his master.
Shall I then take my bread, N my water, N my flesh dat I have killed 4 my shearers, N give it 2 men, whom I know not from where dey be?
So David’s young men turned their way, N went again, N came N told him all dose sayings.

N David said 2 his men, Gird y’all on every man his sword. N dey girded on every man his sword; N David also girded on his sword: N there went up after David about four hundred men; N two hundred stayed by tha stuff.
But one of tha young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, sayin, look, David sent messengers out of tha wilderness 2 greet our master; N he railed on ’em.
But tha men were very good 2 us, N we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant wit ’em, when we were in tha fields:
Dey were a wall 2 us both by night N day, all tha while we were wit ’em keepin tha sheep.
Now therefore know N consider what u will do; 4 evil is determined against our master, N against all his household: 4 he is such a son of Belial, dat a man cannot speak 2 him.

Then Abigail made haste, N took two hundred loaves, N two bottles of wine, N five sheep ready dressed, N five measures of parched corn, N an hundred clusters of raisins, N two hundred cakes of figs, N laid ’em on asses.
N she said 2 her servants, Go on before me; look, I come after u. But she told not her husband Nabal.
N it was so, as she rode on tha ass, dat she came down by tha covert of tha hill, N, look, David N his men came down against her; N she met ’em.
Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all dat dis fellow has in tha wilderness, so dat nothing was missed of all dat pertained 2 him: N he has requited me evil 4 good.
So N more also do God 2 tha opps of David, if I leave of all dat pertain 2 him by tha morning light any dat pisses against tha wall.
N when Abigail saw David, she hasted, N lighted off tha ass, N fell before David on her face, N bowed herself 2 tha ground,
N fell at his feet, N said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let dis iniquity be: N let thine handmaid, I pray u, speak in thine audience, N hear tha words of thine handmaid.

Don’t let my lord, I pray u, regard dis man of Belial, even Nabal: 4 as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, N folly is wit him: but I thine handmaid saw not tha young men of my lord, whom u did send.

Now therefore, my lord, as tha LORD lives, N as ur soul lives, seein tha LORD has withholden u from comin 2 shed blood, N from avenging urself wit ur own hand, now let thine opps, N dey dat seek evil 2 my lord, be as Nabal.
N now dis blessing which thine handmaid has brought 2 my lord, let it even be given 2 tha young men dat follow my lord.
I pray u, forgive tha trespass of thine handmaid: 4 tha LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth tha battles of tha LORD, N evil has not been found in u all ur days.

Yet a man is risen 2 pursue u, N 2 seek ur soul: but tha soul of my lord shall be bound in tha bundle of life wit tha LORD ur God; N tha souls of thine opps, ’em shall he sling out, as out of tha middle of a sling.
N it will happen, when tha LORD shall have done 2 my lord according 2 all tha good dat he has spoken concerning u, N shall have appointed u ruler over Israel;

Dat dis shall be no grief 2 u, nor offence of heart 2 my lord, either dat u have shed blood causeless, or dat my lord has avenged himself: but when tha LORD shall have dealt well wit my lord, then remember thine handmaid.
N David said 2 Abigail, Blessed be tha LORD God of Israel, which sent u dis day 2 meet me:
N blessed be ur advice, N blessed be u, which have kept me dis day from comin 2 shed blood, N from avenging myself wit my own hand.

4 in very deed, as tha LORD God of Israel lives, which has kept me back from hurting u, except u had hasted N come 2 meet me, surely there had not been left 2 Nabal by tha morning light any dat pisses against tha wall.
So David received of her hand dat which she had brought him, N said 2 her, Go up in peace 2 thine house; see, I have listened 2 ur voice, N have accepted ur person.

N Abigail came 2 Nabal; N, look, he held a feast in his house, like tha feast of a king; N Nabal’s heart was merry within him, 4 he was very drunken: so she told him nothing, less or more, until tha morning light.
But it happened in tha morning, when tha wine was gone out of Nabal, N his wife had told him dese things, dat his heart died within him, N he became as a stone.
N it happened about ten days after, dat tha LORD struck Nabal, dat he died.

N when David heard dat Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be tha LORD, dat has pleaded tha cause of my reproach from tha hand of Nabal, N has kept his servant from evil: 4 tha LORD has returned tha wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. N David sent N communed wit Abigail, 2 take her 2 him 2 wife.
N when tha servants of David were come 2 Abigail 2 Carmel, dey spoke 2 her, sayin, David sent us 2 u, 2 take u 2 him 2 wife.
N she arose, N bowed herself on her face 2 tha earth, N said, look, let thine handmaid be a servant 2 wash tha feet of tha servants of my lord.
N Abigail hasted, N arose, N rode upon an ass, wit five damsels of hers dat went after her; N she went after tha messengers of David, N became his wife.
David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; N dey were also both of ’em his wives.
But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, 2 Phalti tha son of Laish, which was of Gallim.

26.text: N tha Ziphites came 2 Saul 2 Gibeah, sayin, does not David hide himself in tha hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?
Then Saul arose, N went down 2 tha wilderness of Ziph, havin three thousand chosen men of Israel wit him, 2 seek David in tha wilderness of Ziph.
N Saul pitched in tha hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by tha way. But David stayed in tha wilderness, N he saw dat Saul came after him in2 tha wilderness.

N David arose, N came 2 tha place where Saul had pitched: N David beheld tha place where Saul lay, N Abner tha son of Ner, tha captain of his host: N Saul lay in tha trench, N tha people pitched round about him.
Then answered David N said 2 Ahimelech tha Hittite, N 2 Abishai tha son of Zeruiah, brother 2 Joab, sayin, Who will go down wit me 2 Saul 2 tha camp? N Abishai said, I will go down wit u.

N David said 2 Abishai, Destroy him not: 4 who can stretch forth his hand against tha LORD’s anointed, N be guiltless?
David said furthermore, As tha LORD lives, tha LORD shall strike him; or his day shall come 2 die; or he shall descend in2 battle, N perish.
Tha LORD forbid dat I should stretch forth mine hand against tha LORD’s anointed: but, I pray u, take u now tha spear dat is at his bolster, N tha cruse of water, N let us go.

So David took tha spear N tha cruse of water from Saul’s bolster; N dey got ’em away, N no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: 4 dey were all asleep; because a deep sleep from tha LORD was fallen upon ’em.
Then David went over 2 tha other side, N stood on tha top of an hill afar off; a great space bein between ’em:
N David cried 2 tha people, N 2 Abner tha son of Ner, sayin, answer u not, Abner? Then Abner answered, Who r u dat criest 2 tha king?
N David said 2 Abner, Art not u a valiant man? N who is like 2 u in Israel? so then have u not kept ur lord tha king? 4 there came one of tha people in 2 destroy tha king ur lord.

Dis thing is not good dat u have done. As tha LORD lives, y’all r worthy 2 die, because y’all have not kept ur master, tha LORD’s anointed. N now see where tha king’s spear is, N tha cruse of water dat was at his bolster.
N Saul knew David’s voice, N said, Is dis ur voice, my son David? N David said, It is my voice, my lord, O king.
N he said, so does my lord like dis pursue after his servant? 4 what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand?

Now therefore, I pray u, let my lord tha king hear tha words of his servant. If tha LORD have stirred u up against me, let him accept an offering: but if dey be tha children of men, cursed be dey before tha LORD; 4 dey have driven me out dis day from abiding in tha inheritance of tha LORD, sayin, Go, serve other gods.
Now therefore, don’t let my blood fall 2 tha earth before tha face of tha LORD: 4 tha king of Israel is come out 2 seek a flea, as when one does hunt a partridge in tha mountains.
Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: 4 I will no more do u harm, because my soul was precious in ur eyes dis day: look, I have played tha fool, N have erred exceedingly.
N David answered, look tha king’s spear! N let one of tha young men come over N fetch it.
Tha LORD render 2 every man his righteousness N his faithfulness: 4 tha LORD delivered u in2 my hand 2 day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against tha LORD’s anointed.
N, look, as ur life was much set by dis day in my eyes, so let my life be much set by in tha eyes of tha LORD, N let him deliver me out of all tribulation.
Then Saul said 2 David, Blessed be u, my son David: u will both do great things, N also will still prevail. So David went on his way, N Saul returned 2 his place.

27.text: N David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by tha hand of Saul: there is nothing better 4 me than dat I should speedily escape in2 tha land of tha Philistines; N Saul shall despair of me, 2 seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.
N David arose, N he passed over wit tha six hundred men dat were wit him 2 Achish, tha son of Maoch, king of Gath.
N David lived wit Achish at Gath, he N his men, every man wit his household, even David wit his two wives, Ahinoam tha Jezreelitess, N Abigail tha Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.
N it was told Saul dat David was fled 2 Gath: N he sought no more again 4 him.
N David said 2 Achish, If I have now found grace in ur eyes, let ’em give me a place in some town in tha country, dat I may live there: 4 why should ur servant live in tha royal city wit u?
Then Achish gave him Ziklag dat day: so Ziklag pertains 2 tha kings of Judah 2 dis day.
N tha time dat David lived in tha country of tha Philistines was a full year N four months.
N David N his men went up, N invaded tha Geshurites, N tha Gezrites, N tha Amalekites: 4 dose nations were of old tha inhabitants of tha land, as u go 2 Shur, even 2 tha land of Egypt.
N David struck tha land, N left neither man nor woman alive, N took away tha sheep, N tha oxen, N tha asses, N tha camels, N tha clothing, N returned, N came 2 Achish.
N Achish said, where have y’all made a road 2 day? N David said, Against tha south of Judah, N against tha south of tha Jerahmeelites, N against tha south of tha Kenites.

N David saved neither man nor woman alive, 2 bring tidings 2 Gath, sayin, Lest dey should tell on us, sayin, So did David, N so will be his manner all tha while he lives in tha country of tha Philistines.
N Achish believed David, sayin, He has made his people Israel utterly 2 abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant 4 ever.

28.text: N it happened in dose days, dat tha Philistines gathered their armies together 4 warfare, 2 fight wit Israel. N Achish said 2 David, Know u assuredly, dat u will go out wit me 2 battle, u N ur men.
N David said 2 Achish, Surely u will know what ur servant can do. N Achish said 2 David, Therefore will I make u keeper of mine head 4 ever.
Now Samuel was dead, N all Israel had lamented him, N buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. N Saul had put away dose dat had familiar spirits, N tha wizards, out of tha land.
N tha Philistines gathered themselves together, N came N pitched in Shunem: N Saul gathered all Israel together, N dey pitched in Gilboa.
